title: Level
body:
Syntax: level

Description: Displays your current ninja level, total experience, the cumulative experience needed to reach the next level (the same Next Level value shown by 'score'), and the exact additional XP still needed. At your ninja rank's cap, XP Needed is 0 and a promotion is required before advancing. Training cap: Student 10. Rank level caps: Genin, Genin 35, Chunin 80, Special Jonin 135, Jonin 200, Elite Jonin 250, Village Elder 250, Kage 250.

Mastery breakthroughs: At levels 100, 125, 150, 175, 200, 225, and 250, jutsu mastered to at least 100% gain an additional 2% combat damage per milestone (14% maximum). Leveling alone provides no jutsu breakthrough bonus without actual proficiency.

Date: 2026-10-21
